The vendor directly providing **Jira** at **atlassian.com** is **Atlassian Pty Ltd**.

### Evidence
* **Exact Product and Domain:** Jira (`atlassian.com`)
* **Provider Statement:** According to the official *Atlassian Customer Agreement* and *Atlassian Product-Specific Terms* (`atlassian.com/legal/product-terms`):
  > *“‘Atlassian’ means the Atlassian entity that owns or operates the Products that Customer uses or accesses listed at https://www.atlassian.com/legal/product-terms.”*
  > 
  > Under the Product-Specific Terms table specifying the contracting entity:  
  > *“All Products not named elsewhere in this table, including Confluence and Jira: **Atlassian Pty Ltd**.”*
